statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
The claim lists diagnoses I48.0 and I47.1
Mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229, was ordered
The service was ordered to accurately characterize the frequency and duration of arrhythmic events for optimal management
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
